openFinding.description: Intermittent focused 100-row filter p95 exceeds 100 ms.

resolvedControlledFindings: UI-PERF-001: zero native reentrancy warnings in final stress runs.
UI-PERF-002: 100-row changing-layout p95 stays below 100 ms in all three final runs.
performance.boundary: Monotonic model/native-layout timing includes a 1 ms yield. Focused search and prior table/selection restoration are setup outside filter timing. Frame presentation, physical scrolling, and large diagnostic XPC transport latency are not measured.

open: Representative power-user tasks: waiting, tracker failure, file priority, seeding contribution, unavailable storage.
Physical pointer/keyboard, live scrolling, focus restoration, and reopening with real transfers.
VoiceOver navigation/speech, actual Reduce Motion and system contrast settings.
Physical external-storage/background lifecycle and distribution signing/notarization.

limitations: Standalone vendored unit suites were not executed: the nested workspace is excluded from the root test command and its offline dependency resolution lacked clap_complete. Root real-loopback and protocol integrations were executed.
A crash can lose payload statistics since the last successful 30-second checkpoint.
Legacy lifetime history and dates remain unknown; verified file bytes are never substituted for network payload history.
No user study or hands-on competitor testing was performed for this implementation.
